name: turntable
description: Setup skills for self-hosting Turntable, plus a channel that pushes CI events (failed runs, approvals needed) into a running Claude Code session.

url.title: Turntable URL
url.description: Base URL of your Turntable server, for example https://ci.example.com

token_file.title: Token file
token_file.description: Absolute path to a file (mode 0600) holding a reader-role token. The token itself is never entered here.
